outcome: vertex presentation at 37 weeks of gestation
cohort: Pregnant women carrying a singleton fetus in breech presentation between 32 and 35 gestational weeks.
finding: Moxibustion application significantly increased the rate of vertex presentation at birth and vaginal delivery compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Moxibustion application increased the vaginal delivery rate.
birth_weight: Varying, measured and analyzed as a secondary factor.
gest_age: Between 32 and 35 gestational weeks at recruitment.
